title: RunState
description: State of one run (SRD 7.6). Terminal states are all except STARTING, RUNNING, and STOPPING. Unknown fields are ignored (PROTO-002).

started_at_ms.description: Start time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

ended_at_ms.description: End time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; present once terminal.

exit_code.description: Process exit code; present for EXITED. Any value is allowed, 0 is success.

signal.description: Signal that stopped the run, when one did.

reason.description: Daemon-supplied explanation for FAILED_TO_START, TIMED_OUT, or CANCELLED.

step.description: Macro progress, when the run belongs to a macro.

total.description: Number of steps in the macro.
